title: Discount Program Fee Relief on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Catch-Up Payment
content:
**Relief schedule.** On a catch-up payment for a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), the discount program on the financed contract gives the program relief share: the military or first-responder program takes the service relief share of 35%; the senior program takes the senior relief share of 25%; no program gives none.

Part of the fee pool, being the late fees, returned-payment fees and phone payment fees posted in the three months before the payment less the fee reversals posted in those months (a pool below zero counts as zero), is left on the balance instead of being collected in the catch-up payment. Where more than one relief share applies to the same catch-up payment, the shares are added together; the relief is the combined share times the fee pool, rounded to the cent and never more than the fee pool, and the catch-up payment is the catch-up figure less the relief, rounded to the cent and never below zero. Every amount rounded to the cent goes to the nearest cent, and an exact half cent rounds up.

The program is the single discount program recorded at signing on the contract the account finances — the Window Replacement Contracts contract or the Entry & Patio Door Contracts contract it funds.

| Discount program on the financed contract | Program relief share of the fee pool |
|---|---|
| Military | 35% |
| First responder | 35% |
| Senior | 25% |
| None | None |

**Hypothetical illustration.** Fee pool 80.00 and a contract carrying the senior program, with no other relief share: relief 25% of 80.00, 20.00; a catch-up figure of 480.00 becomes 460.00.
